source: Qlogue public website and approved public-facing brief, 2026-10-05
text: Qlogue is an independent advisory and technology firm specialising in regulatory transformation and review, AI governance, internal audit and assurance, all underpinned by automation. Qlogue combines specialist regulatory expertise, independent challenge and technology-enabled delivery. adubio is Qlogue's assurance intelligence product. PruQue provides grounded prudential intelligence. Websites: https://qlogue.com, https://adubio.ai and https://pruque.com.

For Qlogue advisory enquiries, adubio demonstrations or licensing, PruQue interest, or general commercial enquiries, email enquiries@qlogue.com. Quole cannot submit enquiries or contact Qlogue on a user's behalf. Never claim that an enquiry has been sent.

Qlogue's services include regulatory transformation and review, AI governance, internal audit and assurance. Automation underpins delivery across these areas. Qlogue works on governance, controls, regulatory interpretation, review, challenge and assurance-related problems in regulated financial institutions. For specific scope or commercial enquiries, direct users to enquiries@qlogue.com.

adubio is Qlogue's assurance intelligence product. It supports continuous assurance, evidence verification, structured review and challenge, and reasoning provenance. Its purpose is to help make the reasoning behind assurance conclusions more traceable and reviewable. Do not describe adubio as providing automatic independent assurance or independent validation simply because it is integrated with another product.

PruQue stands for Grounded Prudential Intelligence. It focuses on prudential calculations, regulatory self-assessment, capital and liquidity-related analysis, scenario analysis and regulatory readiness. Do not imply production availability or specific features unless they are included in approved records.

Qlogue publishes research and insights on model risk, AI governance, assurance, regulatory change and reasoning provenance. The site includes fieldnotes, explainers, benchmarks, interactive tools and research content. Users can explore these through the Insights section on https://qlogue.com.

Qlogue's interactive tools include the AI Regulation Standards Check and the MRM Operating Model Lab. The AI Regulation Standards Check assesses a prompt against selected AI regulations and standards. The MRM Operating Model Lab compares model risk management operating-model choices for governing AI systems. These tools are available through the Try it area of the Qlogue website.

Qlogue has a practitioner community focused on model risk, internal audit, regulatory assurance and AI governance in financial services. The community is intended as a working group for practitioners to exchange knowledge and perspectives. Users can access the Community section from the Qlogue website.

Qlogue's Privacy Notice is available at https://qlogue.com/privacy. Alogue Advisory Ltd is the controller for personal data described in the notice. The notice explains how personal information is collected, used and protected across Qlogue websites and services, including Quole. Quole uses the Google Gemini API to generate responses and Cloudflare Turnstile for bot and abuse prevention. Users should not submit confidential, commercially sensitive, special-category or other sensitive information through Quole. Privacy enquiries can be sent to enquiries@qlogue.com. For the full and current notice, direct users to https://qlogue.com/privacy.

text: Qlogue publishes trust and security information through its website. Quole uses controlled production origins, Cloudflare Turnstile for abuse prevention, rate limits and server-side API credentials. Do not claim certifications, audits, SOC 2 status or security assurances unless they are explicitly stated in approved public records.

The Qlogue website includes Home, Insights, Services, Products, About, Contact, Try it, Community and Privacy content. If a user asks where to find research, direct them to Insights. If they ask about services, direct them to Services. If they ask about interactive tools, direct them to Try it. If they ask about privacy, direct them to https://qlogue.com/privacy.

Qlogue is a trading name of Alogue Advisory Ltd, a company registered in England and Wales. Qlogue was founded by Sayeeka Farnaz. When asked who founded Qlogue, answer that Sayeeka Farnaz is the founder. When asked who owns Qlogue, explain that Qlogue is a trading name of Alogue Advisory Ltd. Do not make claims about shareholding or beneficial ownership unless that information is explicitly included in approved records.
